newsitem.title: MEXICO: Technical bids received for Mexico power plant.
newsitem.headline: Technical bids received for Mexico power plant.

text.p: Mexico's Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) received two technical proposals on Thursday for the construction of its 450-megawatt Rosarito III combined-cycle thermo-electric plant, the CFE said.
A CFE statement said the proposals were received from Mitsubishi Corporation and Japanese-European consortium Nissho Wai-Abb Energy Ventures.
The winning technical bid will be announced during the second half of July, and monetary bids will be accepted from the same date onwards, the statement added.
The original call for bids for Rosarito III was issued in the Mexican Government's Official Gazette of Dec. 10, 1996.
Rosarito III will be built in the Pacific coast state of Baja California.
